## Checklist

- [ ] `tests/run.sh` passes locally, or I explained which suite I could not run.
- [ ] No secrets, real host names, keys or certificates. Examples use placeholders.
- [ ] Documentation in `docs/` is updated, and `tests/check-docs.sh` (strict Sphinx build) passes.
- [ ] New or changed script options, `CODENDUM_*` variables or profiles are documented and recorded in `CHANGELOG.md`.
- [ ] Versions, digests, SHAs and flags were verified against upstream sources.
- [ ] Hardware claims state what was tested and where. Estimates are labelled as estimates.
